notes.title: Stripped of Title is now Playable on Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone. Just a little announcement: the game is now Playable on Steam Deck. It is a bit rough around the edges, and Valve was kind enough to provide feedback on how to improve this port. With time, we will address the feedback to enhance the experience.

Our friends let us try the game on ASUS ROG Ally as well, and it works pretty well, but you have to reduce graphics quality from Epic to get nice stable framerate. This is it for now, happy gaming! ^^

notes.title: Minor patch 1.0.121
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, While we're busy working on bigger updates, we've decided to release a small patch. Here's a list of changes we made:

[list]
[*] Various atmospheric background sounds have been added to all locations for a more immersive experience. This is just the first pass, and we will continue improving the soundscape in future patches.
[*] We have improved the save system. We can now add new quests to old save files. This took a lot of QA work to make sure nothing breaks for existing players.
[*] Now the most curious players can find two tiny secret locations with generous loot hidden in there.
[*] We made a lot of small tweaks to many aspects of the game. For example, in some dungeons it was possible to see through walls from certain angles, this has now been fixed. Such small problems interfere with immersion in the game, and we strive to get rid of them in a timely manner.
[/list]

Thank you, and stay tuned for more news regarding upcoming updates.

notes.title: Future Plans for Stripped of Title
notes.notes:
A few day have passed since the initial release of Stripped of Title. It has been an absolutely crazy week, and we are thankful for your support and all your comments and feedback.

During the last few days we were actively communicating with our players, solving their issues with the game, answering questions, listening to the feedback. We also made a patch to solve some hot issues of various level of severity.

Our team is passionate about this project, and we plan on improving and developing it further. We want each and every one of our players to be satisfied (if you know what I mean, hehe).

During the following few weeks we will implement a number of features from our immediate plan:

[list]
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Steam Cloud Saves
[*] A solution for disappearing markers on 4k screens
[*] New Books and Achievements UIs
[*] Bugfixes for minor issues we didn't have time to address yet
[*] And we want to dramatically improve the soundscape to make the world more alive! :)
[/list]
Once this is done, we will start working on other, more complex improvements of the user experience. At this point, we are not ready to announce anything specific, but we will improve the core gameplay, we'll add new quests and new sex scenes with improved animations and brand new costumes for Bernadette. The possibilities for improvement are endless!

Once again, thank you for your support. Keep in touch, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Milksmith_]Twitter[/url] to be the first to see new updates!

notes.title: Important Patch 1.0.80
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! During the last few days we've been working hard to solve every issue our players have encountered. This patch should fix most known bugs as well as improve some quests for better experience.

- A new repeatable quest with a bunch of new sex animations has been added, and can be accessed next to the cave after the the scared merchant quest. Currently works for New Saves only.
- The quest item in the Cheese quest is now easier to spot for the new players.
- It should be easier to find the solution for the cube puzzle in the Old Forest.
- A new thirsty client appear right in the beginning, allowing the new players to get a taste of what's coming.
- We've added colors to the city to help with navigation a bit.
- In certain circumstances, the players could activate the same quest item twice; it should not be possible now.
- We've added a new trigger to make absolutely sure the players can always interact with the door in the Old Forest.
- SteamVR should no longer launch when the game is opening.
- The carrot scene is now shorter to keep it funny, not obnoxious.
- We've removed film grain from the post-processing as it can cause blurry image on certain screens.
- There was an issue with the New Game function when it didn't fully clean the quest log from the previous playthrough, it should do it correctly now.
- A few new hints will display while adventuring in the Old Forest to remind players about the "M" hotkey that creates a beam of light over the cave leading back to the town.
- A number of insignificant bugs were addressed as well as a few gameplay tweaks were made.

Known issues: we are still investigating an issue that causes issues with quest markers on 4k screens. Temporary solution is to lower screen resolution to 1440p in the game's options.

Thank you, and have fun playing Stripped of Title!

notes.title: Notice: An issue with quest markers on 4k screens
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Some players have reported an issue with the quest markers on 4k screens (3840х2160). A temporary fix is to change the resolution to 1440p (2560×1440) in the game's options, then save the game and load back in. This should correct this issue while we are working on a solution. 

Thank you for understanding.

notes.title: Stripped of Title is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! Today is the day! Our first game, Stripped of Title, will be releasing in just a few hours, and I am beyond excited. It has been a long journey with ups and downs, but a rocky road is not enough to slow us down.

This game is a very ambitious project for a small team of three. During the two years of development we've learned a lot about game development, the tools, the process, and we will use our knowledge to make even better future games. But that is for later...

Post-release, we are committed to improving Stripped of Title as much as we can. There are some areas that need a bit of polishing, and we are already working on it. We also plan on adding various features like Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud Saves, so stay tuned!

[b]Thank you for your support, and see you around![/b]

Make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Milksmith_]Twitter[/url] for more news.
